name: knowledge-synthesis
author: Anthropic and upstream contributors

license.scope: Clean plugin-level Apache-2.0 license applies; full recursive pinned tree shows no overriding license in selected folder. Original source and controlling license retained. External tools and linked works are not relicensed.
obligations: Include complete controlling Apache2 license and preserve attribution/copyright notices.
Preserve any applicable NOTICE text. No source changes proposed; Apache2 modification notices would apply only if changed later.
No trademark rights or third-party service rights are granted.

assignments.essential_function: Turn investor/company document and discussion inputs into attributed briefings with conflicts and uncertainty visible.
Prepare concise,attributed briefings from documents,email,chat and meeting results.

review: Selected unchanged for source-attributed briefing from multiple raw results/documents. Detailed deduplication,authority/freshness/confidence assessment,conflict handling and size-aware summaries. Every claim must have attribution and disagreements remain visible. Portable synthesis instructions have no mandatory native command dispatch or executable dependency. This is last-mile synthesis; retrieval/access must be provided.6.1K installs plus repository evidence support adoption; human authorship is not established.
native_prerequisites: Raw source results or supplied documents with dates,authors,locations and titles.
Optional chat/email/docs/project-tracker retrieval; enterprise-search/CONNECTORS.md explains dynamic categories.
No independent ability to retrieve inaccessible sources or guarantee that input set is complete.
Preserve user-invocable:false: background synthesis guidance over retrieved material, not a standalone retrieval engine or advertised slash command.
